name: Bantock Park Playground
text: A children's play area with monkey bars, swings and multi-play units in Bantock Park, which has a tea room (with toilets) and Bantock House Museum.

name: East Park Playground
text: A large play area for toddlers, juniors and older children, with cradle swings, a small trampoline, see-saws, a roundabout, climbing walls, giant slides and pendulum swings, and a splash pad (currently closed).

name: West Park Playground
text: A children's play area in West Park, a Victorian park near the city centre, with an inclusive roundabout, tearooms, picnic areas and coin-operated toilets.

name: Hickman Park Playground
text: A toddler and children's play area in Hickman Park, Bilston, with mini football pitches, an urban sports court and a ranger building with a toilet and baby changing.

name: Phoenix Park Playground
text: A children's play area with play for all ages in Phoenix Park, Blakenhall, with outdoor fitness equipment, ball courts, a BMX track, a car park and a toilet.
